task.title: P6-113: Filter undone_at in previous_location to fix ReturnToPrevious
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-113. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.

**`previous_location` ignores `undone_at`, so an already-undone move still decides a "return to previous" destination** (was `P6-055h`). `hosted.rs:2202-2210` has no `undone_at IS NULL` predicate; the result feeds `ReturnToPrevious` at `:1240`.
